name: Benunskilled
cooked:
If I disconnect him my average drops like 100ms at least, tried that.

Coming back to the 100 ms: I wouldn’t trust that number. I wasn’t looking at compact blocks back then. Bitcoin Lab now tracks them, and since last night 7 of 42 blocks needed 300–800 kB of missing transactions via getblocktxn, all from AntPool, F2Pool, ViaBTC or SpiderPool (P2A runestone mints, similar to Compact block reconstruction degradation between September - October 2026 - #11 by b10c ). That easily outweighs 100 ms.

@edilmedeiros my guess is the peer mix and quantity matters less than that, and on my old computer less than building the next template by far. Can’t compare other hardware though. Need a few days for more reliable numbers
